business_summary: Guardian Metal Resources is a UK-headquartered exploration company advancing pre-production US tungsten deposits, Pilot Mountain and Tempiute in Nevada, that would add to the thin non-China tungsten feedstock base; a positive Pre-Feasibility Study for Pilot Mountain was announced June 2026 per the company's own website. The company is pre-revenue: vendor-sourced fundamentals show $0 revenue in both FY2024 and FY2025, with an SEC CIK on file (2039972) that has never yet returned annual companyfacts data.

exposure_summary.narrative: GMTL sits on the same upstream feedstock link as Almonty (tungsten-ore-and-scrap-feedstock, scored CROWDED), but at an earlier project stage: pre-production exploration and feasibility rather than active mining and processing. All quantitative figures below rest on the vendor-aggregate fundamentals block, not on a filing this repo has read.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: Guardian Metal Resources is pre-production and pre-revenue; vendor fundamentals show $0 revenue in FY2024 and FY2025, so no exposure percentage applies.

latest_fy.basis: Revenue for the fiscal year ended 2025-06-30 as normalised by yfinance-statements; Guardian Metal Resources is a pre-production explorer with no material revenue. SEC companyfacts for CIK 2039972 returns zero annual fields, so this T3 vendor block is the only available source per method section 6A's 2026-09-01 vendor-aggregate allowance.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Compound annual revenue growth over the 2 fiscal years from 2023-06-30 ($30,000) to 2025-06-30 ($0), computed as (0 / 30000) ** (1/2) - 1 = -1.0 from the vendor-normalised revenue_fy series. This reflects a de minimis pre-production revenue base reaching exactly zero, not a meaningful ongoing decline.

operating_margin.basis: Operating margin is not meaningful: fiscal year 2025-06-30 revenue is $0 (yfinance-statements vendor block), so operating income (-2717000) cannot be expressed as a margin against zero revenue.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow -1122000 divided by net income -2711000, both for the fiscal year ended 2025-06-30, from the yfinance-statements vendor block.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt to EBITDA cannot be computed: total_debt is not present in data/market/GMTL.json fundamentals (the yfinance-statements vendor block has no debt line item for this issuer), and EBITDA itself (operating income -2717000, depreciation_fy also missing) cannot be reliably estimated either.
